Kara: Quick heads-up — Aurora Labs just tripped a hosted spend anomaly this morning. BillingBot auto-flagged it.
BillingBot: [AUTO] spend alert for aurora-labs — 1.12M tokens used in the last 7d; monthly commit = 600k; projected month-end = 4.8M tokens. Alert severity: high. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/aurora-labs
Diego: yikes. Is this all generation or embeddings? Any pattern in endpoints?
Kara: Mostly generation via `/v1/chat` routes (prod and qa). Top route: /generate-stream (60% of tokens). Also spikes around 03:00 UTC daily.
Ayesha: Is this expected from their beta rollout? I thought they capped concurrency.
Sam: They started a new personalization experiment last week, increased prompt length. I flagged the PR but not sure it rolled back.
Diego: Can we throttle or apply per-tenant rate limit while we investigate? If so, what's the fastest path?
Kara: We can enable a temporary policy from Console -> Account Controls -> Rate limits — can apply 5 req/s and a per-minute token cap. I can do it now if everyone agrees.
Ayesha: Do it. Also email legal/finance — possible SLA/commit breach.
Sam: I'll open a quick ticket with infra to check autoscaling logs and KV cache hit rates. tagging @infra-team.
Kara: doing the rate limit change now. (applied 5r/s, 100k tokens/min cap) :white_check_mark:
BillingBot: [UPDATE] policy applied by Kara at 1732001200. Expected to blunt burn within 15m.
Diego: Thanks. Next steps: (1) Sam to check change that increased prompt size, (2) Kara to run a spend forecast sync and offer temporary credit/commit options, (3) Ayesha to notify customer and book 30m call.
Ayesha: On it — I'll draft the email and suggest an emergency call this afternoon PST. 
Sam: noted. Will report back in this thread by EOD with logs and root cause hypothesis.
Kara: I'll also prepare a short summary for finance (numbers + mitigation). Leaving here for now — ping if anything changes. :bell:
